biography: Alexandre Cougnaud, a name synonymous with flair and daring on the Formula Trainer circuit, hails from the sun-drenched vineyards of Cognac, France. His racing journey began not on asphalt, but on the dirt tracks of his family's estate, tearing around in a modified tractor, much to his father's initial dismay. It was during one of these reckless escapades that a local racing scout spotted his raw talent, leading to a scholarship at a prestigious racing academy. Cougnaud quickly rose through the ranks, his aggressive style earning him both victories and a reputation for pushing the limits. After securing a championship in Formula Trainer Advance, he currently drives the N.Otten Skin #23 in Formula Trainer, aiming to prove he can temper his flamboyance with consistent results. While glimpses of brilliance are frequent, converting that into a championship challenge remains his ultimate goal. He needs to recapture the magic of Imola 2021.
drivingStyle: Cougnaud's driving is characterized by aggressive late braking and a willingness to exploit every inch of the track. He's known for his spectacular overtaking maneuvers, often diving down the inside where others wouldn't dare. This 'all or nothing' approach can lead to breathtaking victories, but also costly mistakes. Tire management is not his forte, often sacrificing longevity for early pace. Under pressure, Cougnaud tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes resulting in lock-ups and missed apexes, but occasionally pulling off seemingly impossible passes.
rivalries: Marco Bellini: A tactical, consistent driver who often criticizes Cougnaud's overly aggressive style.
Isabelle Dubois: Another up and coming French driver in a similar stage of her career and both are looking to be the top driver from France.
Kenji Tanaka: A Japanese driver known for his unwavering focus and calm demeanor, often clashing with Cougnaud's more volatile temperament on the track.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of socks, even if they are torn and stained.
Listens to classical music precisely 15 minutes before every race to 'calm the beast within'.
Has a small, hand-carved wooden rooster that he keeps in his helmet bag as a good luck charm.
famousQuote: Second place is just the first loser. I'm here to win, or go down trying.
careerHighlight: Winning the Imola Grand Prix in 2021 after starting from P15, executing a series of daring overtakes in the final laps to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the championship-deciding race in 2022 after attempting an overly ambitious pass, costing him the title and earning him a barrage of criticism.
